title: Blind candidates and seal the assignment ledger
body:
Evaluation harness slice (decision .krn/runs/claude/eval-design/decision.md): krn eval blind builds a judge repository of the base plus one synthetic commit with the candidate tree and fixed metadata, records leakage flags in a sealed ledger, and krn eval ledger unblinds only after every verdict exists.
Acceptance: the blinded repository holds exactly base plus one commit without candidate messages or trailers; unblinding before all verdicts and any change after sealing are refused.
